verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents event-triggered flows that send messages automatically [klaviyo-docs-17], automation building even on the free plan [klaviyo-docs-19], and scheduled recurring tasks [klaviyo-docs-50]. Its AI features include Customer Agent, which resolves order-status questions and sends updates on its own [klaviyo-docs-26], and K:AI, which picks the delivery channel automatically [klaviyo-docs-36]. A community user confirms that event-triggered emails like 'Haven't seen you in a while' run with no extra work [klaviyo-comm-2]. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of flow triggers and background execution behavior, and recent independent hands-on reports of autonomous AI-driven automations (Composer still keeps the user in a review loop [klaviyo-docs-37]).
